stem: A breeding project begins with only two closely related parents even though the target trait is highly variable. What is the strongest design concern?
choices: The starting population may contain limited useful variation for selection
Closely related parents guarantee faster fixation of every desirable trait
Population size no longer matters when parents are named cultivars
Phenotyping can be skipped if the parents look similar
rationale: Breeding response depends partly on useful heritable variation in the starting population. A narrow parental base can limit selectable variation and should be considered when designing the population.
